rules.reason: signed-in users manage sales and purchase orders they created
signed-in users manage line items on orders they created
the orders page is public; it shows a sign-in prompt to visitors

the /orders/track/{token} page is public by design -- this shop's default sale is a guest checkout, so the buyer has no account to sign into and no other way to ask where their order is. The object resolves the order by portal_token with a constant-time compare, never by id, so there is no enumeration path from a guessed order id, and an unknown or blank token gets the same friendly 404 as one that never existed. Public EXECUTE on the page object only -- the orders collection itself stays owner-scoped, exactly the split app-invoices uses for site_invoice_portal
